title: Easy Chicken Enchilada Soup
description: An easy family favorite, this pressure cooker enchilada soup is a hearty mix of beans, corn, tomatoes, and chiles with a Southwestern kick.
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
2 (14 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (14 ounce) can fire-roasted diced tomatoes, with juice

steps.text: Combine chicken breasts, black beans, chicken stock, corn, tomatoes, enchilada sauce, green chiles, onion, garlic, salt, and cumin in a multi-functional pressure cooker. Close and lock the lid. Select Stew mode and cook on high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 30 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, 10 to 40 minutes. Remove chicken, shred it with 2 forks, and return it to the soup.
